modTime.description:
Deprecated: ModTime uses Go's time.String() layout which is not a standard format.
Use ModifiedAt instead, which is serialized as ISO 8601 / RFC 3339.

fetch.description: Fetch fetches from the remote immediately after adding it.

overwrite.description: Overwrite replaces an existing remote with the same name.

files.description: files to add (use . for all files)

depth.description: Depth creates a shallow clone truncated to the given number of commits.

insecure_skip_tls.description:
Skip TLS certificate verification for this clone. Defaults to false (verify).
Set to true ONLY for trusted internal Git servers with self-signed or
private-CA certs; credentials, if supplied, will be transmitted over an
unverified TLS connection and are exposed to any MITM on the route.

value.description: Value is the config value, null when the key is not set.

path.description: Path is the repository path, required when scope is "local".

scope.description: Scope is one of global (default), local or system.

bare.description: Bare creates a repository without a working tree.

initial_branch.description: InitialBranch sets the name of the initial branch.

branch.description: Branch to pull (defaults to the current branch's upstream).
Branch to push (defaults to the current branch).

set_upstream.description: SetUpstream records the pushed branch as the upstream tracking branch.

files.description: Files constrains the reset to the given paths.

mode.description: Mode is one of soft, mixed (default), hard, merge or keep.

target.description: Target is the revision to reset to (defaults to HEAD).

source.description: Source restores file contents from the given revision instead of the index.

staged.description: Staged restores the staging index for the given files.

worktree.description: Worktree restores the working tree for the given files.

path.description: Path is the repository path, required when scope is "local".

scope.description: Scope is one of global (default), local or system.

detached.description: Detached is true when HEAD is not on a branch (detached HEAD state).

upstream.description: Upstream is the upstream tracking branch (e.g. "origin/main"), empty when unset.

escalateAfterMs.description:
EscalateAfterMs escalates to EscalateTo if the process is still alive after
the grace period. This is what makes kill() honest for TERM-trapping
processes: the trap runs and is captured, and the process still dies.

current.description: Current is the name of the checked out branch (empty when HEAD is detached).

pid.description: Pid of the supervised process. Metadata only.

shell.description:
Shell is the requested selector; ResolvedShell is the absolute path the
daemon actually executed. Exposing the resolved path is what makes shell
selection auditable instead of guesswork.

data.description: Data is UTF-8 text when encoding=text, base64 when encoding=base64.

eof.description:
EOF is true when the process is terminal and every retained frame has been
returned.

nextCursor.description:
NextCursor resumes strictly after the last returned frame. It is set even
when Frames is empty so pollers can keep a stable position.

truncatedHead.description:
TruncatedHead reports that the oldest frames of this process were evicted
under a byte cap. Never silently skip: this is the honest signal.

lazyStart.description: Don't start PTY until first client connects
Whether this session uses lazy start

set.description:
Set maps env var names to values applied to the daemon's process env, so
processes spawned after the call (exec, sessions, PTYs) inherit them.

unset.description: Unset lists env var names to remove before Set is applied.

unsetValuePrefix.description:
UnsetValuePrefix removes every env var whose value has this prefix and
whose name is not a key of Set, before Set is applied. Used to reconcile
secret placeholder vars without the caller knowing the daemon's env.
